facts.text: The hotel overlooks Tianfu Square in central Chengdu.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Chengdu, overlooking the city's central Tianfu Square, offers guests an ideal base to explore the best of Chengdu.

facts.text: The hotel stands on the site of what was once an imperial palace.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the site of what was once an imperial palace, The Ritz-Carlton, Chengdu pays homage to the historic splendor of the city's rich past

facts.text: Guest rooms are on the 28th to the 41st floors.
facts.excerpt: With guest rooms from the 28th to the 41st floor, this 350-room luxury hotel features unmatched views of downtown Chengdu

facts.text: Li Xuan Chinese Restaurant specializes in Cantonese and local Sichuanese dishes.
facts.excerpt: Li Xuan Chinese Restaurant specializes in Cantonese and local Sichuanese creations.

facts.text: FLAIR serves Asian-inspired tapas indoors and on an outdoor patio.
facts.excerpt: The stylish FLAIR lounge serves Asian-inspired tapas indoors and on an outdoor patio.

facts.text: SPICES is the all-day dining restaurant, with live-action cooking stations serving international-style dishes.
facts.excerpt: SPICES features live-action cooking stations serving international-style dishes.

facts.text: The Dining Room serves Mediterranean dishes.
facts.excerpt: Explore a variety of fine Mediterranean dishes, and enjoy the flow of creativity with Chef’s delicate crafts.

facts.text: The spa occupies a full floor of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Guests will find relaxation and wellness within a full-floor luxury spa and an indoor swimming pool with underwater music.

facts.text: The indoor swimming pool has an underwater music system.
facts.excerpt: Guests will find relaxation and wellness within a full-floor luxury spa and an indoor swimming pool with underwater music.

facts.text: The spa uses Valmont products and locally sourced teas in its treatments.
facts.excerpt: A selection of innovative treatments makes use of VALMONT products in addition to locally sourced teas.

facts.text: A Kongfu tea performance takes place daily in the 25th-floor hotel lobby.
facts.excerpt: Daily Kongfu Tea performance at 25F hotel lobby at 5pm

facts.text: Complimentary parking is offered to in-house guests.
